title: sombr Announces Dates For 2026 North American You Are the Reason Fall Arena Tour
summary: The 37-date outing is slated to kick off in Colorado at Red Rocks Amphitheater on July 26.
contentText:
sombr is hitting the road for a 37-date fall North American arena tour following a triumphant debut at the Coachella Festival over the weekend. The 20-year-old “Homewrecker” singer announced the dates for his You Are the Reason outing on Monday morning (April 13), which will feature support from Interpol, The Last Dinner Party, Tom Odell, Dove Cameron, Balu Brigadu, King Princess, The Hellp and Hannah Jadagu.

After performing at the Pepsi Center in Mexico City on July 22, the tour will open its U.S./Canadian leg with a show at the iconic Red Rock Amphitheater in Morrison, Colo. on July 26, before moving on to Vancouver, Seattle, Portland, Sacramento, San Jose, Anaheim, Los Angeles, San Diego, Houston, Dallas, Atlanta, Orlando, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Chicago, Detroit, Pittsburgh, Toronto, Boston and Philadelphia, winding down on Nov. 23 with a hometown show at New York’s legendary Madison Square Garden.

An artist presale will begin on Tuesday (April 14) at 10 a.m. local, followed by a Spotify presale on Thursday (April 16) at 10 a.m. local time and a general onsale beginning on Friday (April 17) at 10 a.m. local; click here for additional ticketing information.

After teaming up with Smashing Pumpkins leader Billy Corgan on his band’s 1996 single “1979” on Saturday (April 11) for a set that drew a massive crowd at Coachella, sombr will release a new single, “Potential,” on Thursday (April 16). The track is the follow to “Homewrecker,” which peaked at No. 24 on the Billboard Hot 100 in February.
